title: Distinct classmates of student 1
statementMd:
List students who share at least one course in the same semester with student 1 (excluding student 1). Show student id and how many shared course-semesters.

Expected columns: `student_id`, `shared`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Self-join enrollments on course and semester.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT b.student_id, COUNT(*) AS shared FROM enrollments a JOIN enrollments b ON a.course_id = b.course_id AND a.semester = b.semester AND b.student_id <> a.student_id WHERE a.student_id = 1 GROUP BY b.student_id;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
